dct_title_s: Damage assessment over Kardashynka Village, Kokhany Village and surroundings, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR** This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters and affected structures over Kardashynka and Kokhany Villages and surroundings in Khersonska Oblast (Ukraine) as detected from a WorldView-3 image acquired on 7 June 2023 at 08:19 UTC; and ICEYE image acquired on 7 June 2023. Within the analysed area of 27 km², about 81% (22 km²) of Kardashynka Village, and Kokhany Village and surrounding area appears to be flooded. 8,728 structures and 38 harbours are affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
